subject: v0.12.12 offline BDX native-call catalog expansion

checks.name: Independent original-PE metadata
checks.details: A separate PE section reader verified all 150 descriptor RVAs, stored handler pointers and flags directly against the hash-pinned retail executable. Recorded complete 16-byte records also retain padding. All 11 recorded original registry slots match; dynamic bank3/bank9 slots are original NULL. Their installed-variant table identities are inherited from reviewed registry evidence, not inferred from NULL.

checks.name: Exact annotation transfer
checks.details: All 60 new names/summaries/notes/evidence strings equal their source annotation files byte-for-byte as decoded strings: System33 and Object27. All 104 annotated entries are accounted for. The 44 old annotations remain exact except the authorized 2:9/95 notes/evidence suffixes. Every descriptor metadata field, all banks and row order remain identical to the frozen prior catalog. The shipped v0.12.11 resource equals that frozen base.

checks.name: Self-link language
checks.details: The 2:9/95 addition says Actor+4 stores an encoded self pointer and an intact Actor can satisfy the wrapper ABI. It explicitly says a separate wrapper allocation is not universally required and the selected 1:87 Event27 witness does not prove Event27 calls to 2:9/95. Original constructor evidence was independently reviewed by root in the pinned Motion receipt.

checks.name: Reproducible builder
checks.details: build_catalog.py --check completed successfully. Product JSON equals expansion catalog-data.json exactly; catalog-sources.json source hashes and 60-key set match actual sources. The builder does not alter descriptor numeric fields and has explicit count/arity/return checks. System0:29 final text already includes signed integer duration/count and the explicit zero interpolation duration.

checks.name: Unchanged API and integration boundary
checks.details: The production catalog API, BdxInspection decoder, embedded-resource csproj, AssetScriptViewModel, AssetExplorerView XAML and code-behind are byte-identical to v0.12.11 Source.zip. All 52 packaged Bridge source files are likewise byte-identical. Scope comments still separate captured extents from native bounds and metadata from valid runtime calls.

checks.name: Compiled bounded probe
checks.details: Compiled the actual production catalog source and current JSON under the exact production manifest resource name, together with current bounded CatalogTests. Verified every row numeric field and name/summary/notes/evidence through Lookup, Details and SearchText. Confirmed no public catalog constructor/setters/storage, readonly FrozenDictionary backing fields and record-copy isolation. Embedded resource SHA256 equals reviewed product JSON. No full numeric oracle rerun.

checks.name: Tests and dark UI
checks.details: Reviewed exact Core/Ui test diff against packaged v0.12.11 sources. The former unannotated Bank0 fixture correctly moved to Bank9; new cases cover all captured nonnull Bank0 annotations, raw Keyblade setter limits, discarded transform, antiparallel direction, effect cleanup, save limits, child VM exit and Actor self-link. Existing UI report is PASS79 checks/6 renders/0 binding errors/0 windows; read, not rerun here. Visually inspected the newly saved Keyblade render: dark readable layout and bounded scrolling detail area.

limits: This is an independent offline integration review, not an independent complete semantic reanalysis of all 104 native handlers. New text content is pinned to the separately reviewed System/Object studies; six math annotations were independently analyzed by this reviewer in the referenced receipt.

The standalone compiled probe uses the actual unchanged production source and resource configuration; it does not claim to validate a final packaged EXE that had not yet been built. Root-reported Core3250 and UI79/6 tests are not attributed to this review as rerun results.
No target code, BDX script, live game, process attachment, UI automation, injection, save or mod write occurred. Only this review artifact directory and its top-level receipt/text were written.

The expansion manifest was not yet present at review completion; this receipt pins concrete builder/product/source/support hashes. It can be copied into the subsequent package manifest without a self-referential manifest hash.

reproduction.portability: Probe.csproj locates the repository by Directory.Build.props, and check_catalog.py by Directory.Build.props plus src/KH2Trainer.Core. They can be copied to a study folder without source path edits; replace their command directory with the new location. The compiled probe uses the actual production source/resource and current catalog test file. The metadata verifier additionally requires the hash-pinned original EXE and previous artifacts/packages/KH2_Trainer_v0.12.11/Source.zip for its frozen-base equality check. --check never overwrites its receipt.
